## R5 focused source-control corrections

The [R4 independent review](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/reviews/midi-tools-owner-r4-review.json)
required three corrections. Recombine uses the Dimension chooser; display-column
dragging sets Rotation Steps, and Position is selected before Rotate on Grid.
Strum Low/High have the documented breakpoint/keyboard entries; Tension remains
a separately admitted control without those gesture assumptions. Euclidean has
individual Rotation sliders and one middle Pattern randomization button setting
the sliders for each voice, not separately targeted per-voice randomize controls.

The [current R5 catalog](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/midi-editing/acceptance-cases-r5.json)
keeps43IDs/93cases,77D12/16U and all old documentary/actual oracles/source claims
exact. Only three existing appended clauses and MED084/086/093 setup actions
are corrected; all72pre-R4records remain exact. Productive nonzero Strum before
zero and actual NONEMPTY generator output before bounds/capacity/origin/absence
remain required. No distinct random realization, numeric/curve/time/file/protocol
law or C1/C2/C3/MTA-Q04 resolution follows. All actual outcomes stay null/U/not-run.
All55R4/history files remain exact in place. No historical checker or adapter
is run; current own immutable inputs and [exact correction](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/midi-editing/correction-r5.json)
govern this successor.

owns current disposition. The earlier R4 review withheld approval; this is no
self-approval or full17tool/exact-build completion.

## R5 focused source-role correction

The [complete independent R4 review](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/reviews/midi-tools-owner-r4-review.json)
withheld approval on three source-role errors despite passing mechanical checks.
B075 supplies a Dimension chooser, B078 display-column Rotation Steps gestures,
and B079 Position before Rotate on Grid. B093 breakpoint/keyboard entries name
Low and High; B094 does not establish those gestures for Tension. B143 has one
middle randomization button for the voices Rotation sliders, distinct from
individual sliders/toggles. B144 voices pitch/velocity/arrows remain separate.

R5 corrects only those appended clause/entry associations and three setup actions.
The [precise delta](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/midi-editing/correction-r5.json)
records all literal changes; every source_claim, source pointer, oracle, guard,
case ID and count remains exact. Current43IDs/93cases (77D12/16U), all actual
null/U/unexecuted, and all55prior files stay preserved. No archive duplication,
old writer/checker replay, mutable external gate or adapter is added. The full
146block/43row/93action independent review is carried only for unchanged material;
R5 requires separate focused review of these corrections.

[Current cases](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/midi-editing/acceptance-cases-r5.json)
retain productive nonzero Strum before zero and genuine NONEMPTY generator
output before bounds/capacity/origin/absence. Randomize does not promise distinct
results. C1/C2/C3/MTA-Q04, loop/selection precedence, built-in editability, Q052/Q053,
all target-build and source-silent lifecycle uncertainties remain open. No new
numeric/DSP/curve/RNG/file/protocol/time law, image inspection or runtime follows.

owns current disposition. No full family or compatibility approval is claimed.
